message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of all the material choices our sculptor offers:

| Material   | Typical Finish & Feel |
|------------|-----------------------|
| **Bronze** | Classic patina; durable outdoors/indoors |
| **Marble** | Elegant white‑to‑gray stone; great for indoor display |
| **Terracotta** | Warm earthy tone; rustic charm |
| **Wood** | Natural grain; versatile (oak, walnut, maple) |
| **Stone** | Dense, timeless look (granite, limestone, etc.) |

If you’re set on a *bronze* piece, let me know the exact dimensions (inches), any special detailing you'd like, and whether it’ll be displayed indoors or outdoors so I can tailor the finish accordingly. If you’d prefer another material—or even a mix—just tell me which one(s) interest you!
